inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. A fortified kill zone: sharpened spike walls, a catapult aimed at the arena, a horned beast chained to a tree, skulls on pikes, war banners, and a cheerful skeleton merchant selling souvenirs. This is one stop of a long connected region, composed as a real place rather than a flat strip: a spiked barricade of crossed wooden stakes in the near foreground, in shadow.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth", "lighting": "Bright warm daylight from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the arena in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#5aa6e4", "#b0daf0", "#f6e4c4", "#9692c4", "#ecb050", "#b46e3c", "#d04a3a", "#56925c", "#96a0bc", "#3a3a52", "#e8e0d0"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no people. The top third is sky over the distant Bloodridge burial ridge. Behind the arena the scenery stands in overlapping rows at different depths. A spiked barricade of crossed wooden stakes in the near foreground, in shadow. The lower part is the flat arena floor, calm and empty in the middle. The picture continues seamlessly at its left and right edges.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 300, 1000], "desc": "a bright clear sky with circling vultures over the long Bloodridge burial ridge on the horizon, carved with tomb terraces and dark tomb doors, the chief's stepped pyramid court on its crest, the same sky as before"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [611, 350, 1000, 655], "desc": "a spiked barricade of crossed wooden stakes in the near foreground, in shadow"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [480, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a calm packed grey stone arena with faint painted lines, nothing busy, calm and empty in the middle, a worn path and long cracks running back toward the scenery"}]}}
